data.title: A New Chapter for Africa’s Oldest Zoo: Giza Zoo Returns to the Global Stage at the 81st WAZA Annual Conference
data.description:
A New Chapter for Africa’s Oldest Zoo: Giza Zoo Returns to the Global Stage at the 81st WAZA Annual Conference

Following an ambitious transformation to modernize the historic landmark, Giza Zoo participates in the global gathering for the first time in 30 years, marking a significant step toward international accreditation.

This week, amidst the international delegates gathered at Cologne Zoo for the 81st Annual Conference of the World Association of Zoos and Aquariums (WAZA), a historic moment unfolded, where for the first time in 30 years, Egypt’s historic Giza Zoo is participating in the global summit taking place from October 25 to 29, 2026, hosted by Cologne Zoo in Germany.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261031782229/en/

Giza Zoo Delegation (Photo: AETOSWire)

This long-awaited return marks a significant milestone in Giza Zoo’s ambitious transformation journey, as one of the world’s oldest zoological institutions works to reclaim its place within the international zoological community. More than a symbolic reconnection, the participation reflects a renewed commitment to international standards, animal welfare, and wildlife conservation, as the zoo progresses along a structured pathway toward global accreditation and membership.

At the heart of this new chapter is a comprehensive, multi-phase redevelopment project aimed at restoring Giza Zoo’s historic significance while transforming it into a modern, world-class destination for conservation, education, and research. Led by Egyptian developer Hadayieq under a 25-year concession agreement covering both Giza Zoo and the neighboring Orman Garden, the transformation brings together leading international zoo-planning specialists, veterinary experts, and Egyptian scientific leadership to revitalize the landmark institution.

The redevelopment goes far beyond physical restoration. From redesigning animal habitats and upgrading enclosures to modernizing life-support systems and operational practices, the project is guided by international benchmarks, drawing on African association for wildlife in human care standards alongside selected guidelines from the Association of Zoos and Aquariums (AZA). Animal welfare, environmental education, scientific research, and wildlife conservation remain central to the transformation, laying the foundations for a more sustainable future.

While embracing modern zoological practices, the project is equally committed to preserving the zoo’s remarkable heritage. Founded in 1891 on the historic royal grounds laid out by Khedive Ismail, Giza Zoo holds the distinction of being Africa’s first zoo and one of the oldest zoological gardens in the world. With its rare botanical collections, historic architecture, and iconic suspension bridge designed by Gustave Eiffel, the zoo has long been an important part of Egypt’s cultural identity. The ongoing renovation seeks to honor this legacy while reimagining the experience for future generations.

The progress achieved through this transformation has drawn recognition from the international zoological community. Welcoming Giza Zoo’s historic return, David Field, WAZA President, emphasized the significance of the project, stating: “Reconnecting historic zoos like Giza Zoo with the global community is at the heart of our mission. As Africa’s first zoo, Giza Zoo carries a remarkable legacy, and its commitment to international standards and animal welfare is an encouraging step forward. Three years is an incredibly short time for a transformation of this scale. Revitalizing such a historic institution requires extensive research, meticulous planning, and a commitment to getting every detail right.”

He added: “The progress achieved in just three years is remarkable, but a transformation of this magnitude cannot happen overnight. What matters most is building a lasting legacy that prioritizes animal welfare, conservation, and meaningful visitor experiences. By taking the time to meet the highest international standards, Giza Zoo is laying the foundations for a world-class destination that serves its animals, inspires its visitors, and makes Egypt proud for generations to come.”

Beyond international recognition, Giza Zoo’s renewed engagement with WAZA opens opportunities for greater collaboration with leading zoological institutions worldwide. Through knowledge exchange and access to international expertise, the zoo aims to strengthen its capabilities in endangered species breeding, veterinary research, and conservation initiatives, supporting its long-term ambition to become an active contributor to global wildlife preservation.

As the transformation continues, Giza Zoo’s return to the international stage represents more than the revival of a historic landmark. It signals the beginning of a new era that brings together over 130 years of heritage with modern science, conservation, and animal welfare. With a clear vision for the future, the redevelopment aims to restore Giza Zoo as a leading conservation and educational destination, creating a lasting legacy for future generations of Egyptians while reaffirming its place on the global zoological map.

*Source: AETOSWire

Khaled Tarek

data.title: Race for Life Rescue Marks 200 Rescue Flights Carrying Shelter Animals to New Homes
data.description:
Race for Life Rescue Marks 200 Rescue Flights Carrying Shelter Animals to New Homes

Race for Life Rescue Marks 200 Rescue Flights Carrying Shelter Animals to New Homes

PR Newswire

ANNAPOLIS, Md., Oct. 31, 2026

From a Hurricane Ian evacuation in 2022 to more than 12,000 dogs and cats flown, the nonprofit has helped shelters in more than 30 states

ANNAPOLIS, Md., Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- Race for Life Rescue, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that flies at-risk dogs and cats from overcrowded shelters and disaster zones to shelters with room and waiting adopters, completed its 200th rescue mission on Oct. 14, flying 112 animals from Louisiana to the Northeast. The milestone comes four years after the organization's first flight. Since then, it has flown more than 12,000 animals, working with shelters in more than 30 states.

 Race for Life Rescue has flown more than 12,000 shelter animals on 200 rescue flights since its first in 2022.

Through Dec. 31, founder Jim DeFrancesco is matching every donation, so each gift to keep the plane flying does twice the good.

"An airplane is simply a machine until you give it a purpose," said Jim DeFrancesco, founder and chief pilot of Race for Life Rescue. "When the aircraft door opens at the destination and you see rescue workers waiting to receive them, you realize that the flight wasn't simply transportation. For those animals, it was a flight to a new life."

It started with one flight

On Oct. 2, 2022, Race for Life Rescue flew its first mission, carrying relief supplies from Nashville, Tennessee, to Naples, Florida, after Hurricane Ian. The plane returned with nearly 40 displaced cats bound for adoption. Since then, the team has averaged about one mission a week, with 49 missions and 3,267 animals flown so far in 2026. Every flight is planned with shelter partners and tracked on the organization's flight map.

A commuter plane, rebuilt for rescue

Race for Life Rescue at a glance:

  • Aircraft: a 1999 Beechcraft 1900D, a 19-passenger commuter plane converted to carry more than 100 crated animals in a climate-controlled cabin
  • Range: about 1,000 nautical miles in under five hours, a trip that can take 20 to 25 hours by road
  • Registered with the U.S. Department of Agriculture as an animal carrier
  • Sending shelters screen every animal before boarding, and a partner representative flies on every mission

Shelters don't pay for flights. Race for Life Rescue covers the cost with support from donors, foundations and partners, including BISSELL Pet Foundation and the ASPCA, who help connect overcrowded shelters with places that have room.

How to help

Follow every mission on Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn, or donate to fund the next flight. Learn more at raceforliferescue.org.

About Race for Life Rescue

Race for Life Rescue is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit that provides lifesaving air transport for dogs and cats threatened by euthanasia, natural disasters or unsafe living conditions. Founded in 2021 by Jim and Pam DeFrancesco, it flies animals from overcrowded shelters and disaster areas to partner shelters where they can be adopted. Its aircraft is based in Nashville, Tennessee, and its office is in Annapolis, Maryland. Learn more at raceforliferescue.org.

data.title: GLOBAL VOTING FOR 7 WONDERS OF FUTURE CITIES OFFICIALLY SWITCHED ON
data.description:
GLOBAL VOTING FOR 7 WONDERS OF FUTURE CITIES OFFICIALLY SWITCHED ON

GLOBAL VOTING FOR 7 WONDERS OF FUTURE CITIES OFFICIALLY SWITCHED ON

PR Newswire

DUBAI, UAE, Oct. 31, 2026

DUBAI, UAE, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- New Clark City, Philippines, hosts "switch-on" ceremony as New7Wonders opens worldwide public voting on www.7wondersfc.com to choose the urban developments shaping our future.

New7Wonders today officially launched global public voting for the 7 Wonders of Future Cities, in a landmark ceremony hosted in the Philippines on World Cities Day, marking the beginning of a year of worldwide participation, inviting people everywhere to vote for the cities and urban developments they believe best represent the future of urban life, which will culminate with the official declaration of the seven winning cities and developments on 31 October 2027. 

Hosted and organised by New Clark City, an Official Participant in the 7 Wonders of Future Cities campaign and one of the Philippines' flagship urban development projects, the special switch-on ceremony brought together city leaders, media and invited guests to witness the activation of the global voting platform. 

Jean-Paul de la Fuente, Director of New7Wonders and Chairman of the 7 Wonders of Future Cities campaign, led the official switch-on. In a ceremonial moment, the campaign website at www.7wondersfc.com was transformed from its presentation format into the worldwide public voting platform, opening the opportunity for citizens across the globe to participate in selecting the urban visions that will define the cities of tomorrow. "Today, from the Philippines to the world, we have switched on more than a voting platform - we have switched on a global conversation about the future of our cities," said de la Fuente. "For the next year, people everywhere have the opportunity to discover, engage with and champion the places they believe should become global symbols of urban progress."

The 7 Wonders of Future Cities is a worldwide participation campaign from New7Wonders, the global authority behind the New 7 Wonders of the World and the New 7 Wonders of Nature, and is organised by Global Platform Limited, its Dubai, UAE-based worldwide licensing and commercial arm. Building on the extraordinary worldwide engagement of previous campaigns, which together have generated more than 600 million votes, the new initiative shifts the focus from celebrating humanity's natural and historical wonders to recognising the places being created and transformed for humanity's future. Participating cities and developments are brought together through three central themes: Environmental & Nature, Smart City and Human-Centric development. These reflect the conviction that successful future cities must balance ecological responsibility, technological progress and the needs and aspirations of the people who inhabit them.

data.title: United States Signs Participation Contract for Expo 2030 Riyadh, Strengthening Momentum For Global Participation
data.description:
United States Signs Participation Contract for Expo 2030 Riyadh, Strengthening Momentum For Global Participation

The United States of America has signed its Participation Contract for Expo 2030 Riyadh, marking a significant milestone in the World Expo’s preparations and further strengthening the momentum for international participation in the global event.

This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20261031669001/en/

The Participation Contract was signed by His Highness Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, during a bilateral meeting held on the sidelines of the 2026 G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, Georgia.

The signing marks an important step in the United States’ journey towards Expo 2030 Riyadh, paving the way for the development of its pavilion, programming and visitor experience. It also reinforces the growing international commitment to Expo 2030 Riyadh, as countries move from confirming their participation to actively shaping the experiences, ideas and innovations they will bring to the Kingdom in 2030.

The Participation Contract was signed by His Highness Prince Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud, Minister of Foreign Affairs of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, and U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio, during a bilateral meeting held on the sidelines of the 2026 G20 Foreign Ministers’ Meeting in Atlanta, Georgia. The signing ceremony was attended by Her Royal Highness Princess Reema bint Bandar bin Sultan bin Abdulaziz Al-Saud, Ambassador of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia to the United States, and Talal Al-Marri, CEO of Expo 2030 Riyadh.

Building on its longstanding tradition of participation in World Expos, the United States will develop its presence on a dedicated plot within Expo 2030 Riyadh’s Technology precinct. Its participation will offer an opportunity to showcase American innovation, creativity and technological leadership, while contributing to the Expo’s theme, “Foresight for Tomorrow.”

The United States joins a growing number of countries that have formalised their participation in Expo 2030 Riyadh, reflecting continued progress in international engagement. More than 185 Official Participants have confirmed participation, with preparations advancing across pavilion planning, content development and programming. Each new contract marks a further step in translating international commitments into a robust and compelling World Expo experience.

Meanwhile, work continues to progress across the Expo site in northern Riyadh, with infrastructure development and construction of key assets advancing. Together, these milestones demonstrate the progress being made on both fronts: building the physical foundations of Expo 2030 Riyadh and bringing together the international participants who will shape its content and visitor experience.

Held under the theme “Foresight for Tomorrow,” Expo 2030 Riyadh will take place from 1 October 2030 to 31 March 2031, bringing together countries and international organisations from around the world and welcoming more than 42 million visits over six months. Through its five thematic areas - Technology, Planet, Humanity, Culture and Collaboration - the Expo will provide a global platform for nations to share their achievements and ambitions, explore solutions to shared challenges and inspire new possibilities for the future.

About Expo 2030 Riyadh

Running from 1 October 2030 to 31 March 2031, Expo 2030 Riyadh will be among the most ambitious World Expos ever conceived with a 6 million square meter site that will bring together 197 Official Participants and is expected to welcome 42 million visits across 5 distinct districts.

Held under the theme “Foresight for Tomorrow,” and hosted in Riyadh - a city of action and ambition - Expo 2030 Riyadh will provide a platform for participants to exchange ideas, shape solutions, and build partnerships that drive real impact, address global challenges, and unlock new opportunities. The World Expo will feature immersive cultural zones, daily activations, and AI-powered interactions, blending traditional Saudi hospitality with cutting-edge technology. Following the six-month event, the Expo site will evolve into a vibrant destination, continuing to attract visitors and contribute to Riyadh’s dynamic urban landscape.

For more information, please visit: https://www.expo2030riyadh.sa/en/

For media inquiries, please contact media@expo2030riyadh.sa

data.title: SCANOLOGY Introduces AirGO Pad for On-Site 3D Scanning, Inspection and Reporting
data.description:
SCANOLOGY Introduces AirGO Pad for On-Site 3D Scanning, Inspection and Reporting

SCANOLOGY Introduces AirGO Pad for On-Site 3D Scanning, Inspection and Reporting

PR Newswire

HANGZHOU, China, Oct. 31, 2026

HANGZHOU, China, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- SCANOLOGY introduces AirGO Pad, an integrated mobile measurement platform that brings 3D scanning, inspection and reporting alongside the part being measured. Combining computing, industrial 3D inspection software and touchscreen operation, AirGO Pad works with compatible SCANOLOGY wireless 3D scanners to help operators complete the inspection workflow on-site without carrying a separate laptop.

When inspecting a large component, operators need to move around the part while keeping scan data and measurement controls accessible. Finding a suitable place for a laptop—and returning to it to check results or adjust settings—can interrupt that process, particularly where space is limited. AirGO Pad places the inspection interface on a portable tablet, allowing operators to view data and interact with the software beside the component.

Users can connect a compatible wireless 3D scanner and view 3D data in real time, monitoring scan coverage and quality as they work. They can then align data, perform measurements and inspect results on the same device. During scanning, operators can create comparison points, features and other inspection elements as needed. Preconfigured report templates complete the workflow, enabling standardized inspection reports to be generated directly on AirGO Pad.

The platform's design supports these transitions between scanning, inspection and reporting. Its high-definition touchscreen keeps model details and measurement results within reach. Operators can use the tablet in handheld mode while moving around the part, then unfold the convertible stand to review results on a suitable surface. A neck strap provides additional support when carrying and operating the device.

"Making a measurement system mobile means considering more than how operators carry the 3D scanner. They also need access to their data and inspection tools beside the part. We developed AirGO Pad to bring these activities together, from reviewing scan data to producing the inspection report," said a product manager at SCANOLOGY.

AirGO Pad supports SCANOLOGY's third-generation handheld and wireless optical 3D scanning systems, standard CAD/3D formats and wireless PC synchronization for measurement, annotation and review.

For product details or to request a demonstration, visit AirGo Pad product page.

About SCANOLOGY

SCANOLOGY develops industrial 3D measurement solutions for manufacturing and engineering. Its products are used for 3D measurement, automated inspection, and quality control. They are trusted by more than 10,000 enterprises across over 70 countries and regions, serving industries such as aerospace, automotive, and heavy manufacturing.

data.title: HK tightens oversight of building repair work
data.description:
HK tightens oversight of building repair work

HK tightens oversight of building repair work

PR Newswire

HONG KONG, Oct. 31, 2026

HONG KONG, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- A report from chinadailyhk.com

The Hong Kong SAR government will launch the first phase of a centralized database for the records of building maintenance projects and professionals in May or June next year, while a new public body will assist local homeowners with the oversight of repair or renovation works from January.

The special administrative region authorities also aim to amend several ordinances to enhance crackdowns on bid-rigging and other anti-competition conduct by April.

The moves are part of the city's reforms proposed following Thursday's release of the report of an independent committee inquiry into the Wang Fuk Court blaze on Nov 26, 2025, which killed 168 people and displaced nearly 2,000 families. The report contains the judge-led panel's analysis of the cause of the fire, the system deficiencies it identified, and its recommendations for improvement.

Speaking on a radio program on Friday, Chief Secretary for Administration Eric Chan Kwok-ki said he was confident that the implementation of most of the measures proposed could begin within months.

Chan, who leads a steering committee tasked with reviewing the independent inquiry's recommendations and overseeing implementation of the proposed reforms, said the committee will hold its first meeting in November to examine in detail how to implement the proposed measures.

Chan said some measures were already being taken forward or put into effect, including amendments to six ordinances that the government is set to table in the Legislative Council by the end of this year.

But he said that the proposed centralized data system could take several months to build, as it will involve converting existing data from the data banks of various departments and developing the platform.

Chan said he believes this system will be helpful for reviewing contractors' work.

Separately, at two media briefings on Friday, officials explained how the government will support local homeowners under the new Building Maintenance Support and Services Council and criminalize bid-rigging.

Secretary for Development Bernadette Linn Hon-ho said that the council — which is set to begin operations by the end of this year, with services being launched in January — will support owners and oversee project parties involved in building inspections, tender preparations, bid evaluations and construction.

Officials said that the council's free services include providing lists of trustworthy consultants and contractors, templates of tender documents and engineering contracts, as well as the cost data from past projects, enabling homeowners to conduct bidding procedures and hire consultants and contractors.

With its paid service package — which is compulsory for homeowners applying for government repair subsidies and estimated to cost a few thousand Hong Kong dollars per household — the council will act as an agent in the recruitment of building inspection consultants and will review inspection reports, while also helping homeowners during bidding, construction and more.

Secretary for Commerce and Economic Development Algernon Yau Ying-wah said the authorities are considering criminalizing four types of serious anti-competition conduct involving tenders for building maintenance and renovation projects, namely bid-rigging, price-fixing, market sharing and output restrictions.

data.title: Drive to Great | BAIC FOTON Africa Partners Conference Successfully Held, Accelerating Localization Strategy

Drive to Great | BAIC FOTON Africa Partners Conference Successfully Held, Accelerating Localization Strategy

Drive to Great | BAIC FOTON Africa Partners Conference Successfully Held, Accelerating Localization Strategy

PR Newswire

PORT ELIZABETH, South Africa, Oct. 31, 2026

PORT ELIZABETH, South Africa, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On October 29, the BAIC FOTON Africa Partners Conference, themed "Drive to Great," was held at Nelson Mandela Bay Stadium in Port Elizabeth, South Africa. Nearly 700 participants attended, including Chinese and African political and business representatives, senior executives from BAIC Group and BAIC FOTON, and distributors, key accounts, industrial partners, and media from 42 African countries.

Strategic anchoring and deeper whole-value-chain cooperation

BAIC FOTON has ranked first in China's commercial vehicle sales for 21 consecutive years and first in exports for 15 consecutive years, covering more than 140 countries and regions. From January to September 2026, export sales exceeded 168,500 units, up 43.6% year on year. In Africa, its business covers 54 markets with more than 300 authorized service outlets. At the conference, Chang Rui, CEO of BAIC Group and Chairman of the Board of BAIC FOTON, and customer representatives completed delivery of 1,000 heavy trucks in Ghana and 800 heavy trucks in Zambia. Wu Zongtian, President of BAIC FOTON International, and customer representatives signed new energy product projects: 200 units in Mozambique, 100 in Ethiopia, 100 in Kenya, and a batch project in Zambia, covering green transition scenarios in mining, agriculture, and other industries. Wu Zongtian released BAIC FOTON's internationalization and Africa regional strategy report, proposing three pillars: localized product portfolio, localized business ecosystem, and localized manufacturing and operations. BAIC FOTON will deploy fuel, natural gas, battery electric, and plug-in hybrid technology routes, using South Africa to activate Southern Africa and drive coordinated breakthroughs in East Africa, North Africa, and West Africa.

Product matrix expanded and localized manufacturing advanced

Two heavy trucks, GALAXUS R5 and GALAXUS C5, were officially launched in Africa, and the TUNLAND V PHEV pickup was released for Africa, expanding supply for heavy-duty logistics and multi-purpose mobility. Relying on 16 localized factories in Africa, BAIC FOTON continued manufacturing cooperation. At the strategic signing session, Dai Hongkai, Party Secretary of BAIC FOTON International, completed six localized manufacturing cooperation signings with partners in Tanzania, Kenya, and Zimbabwe. BAIC FOTON also advanced vehicle purchase support cooperation with WesBank and an African parts center warehouse cooperation with DP World, providing full-chain support for African users.

Market promotion deepened and GALAXUS set sail in Africa

The conference held a partners award ceremony, recognizing outstanding partners in key account development, new energy promotion, aftermarket services, and distributor cooperation. Luo Yunjie, VP of BAIC FOTON International, announced the launch of the Africa leg of the FOTON GALAXUS Global Experience and presented flags to distributor representatives from Tanzania, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Zambia, and Zimbabwe. BAIC FOTON will continue working with local partners to deepen localized manufacturing and industrial collaboration, improve regional supply and operation service systems, and jointly embark on the new journey of "Drive to Great."

data.title: TCL Donates Ultra-Low-Power Display System to the Youth Olympic Village, Bringing Advanced Display Technology to Everyday Use
data.description:
TCL Donates Ultra-Low-Power Display System to the Youth Olympic Village, Bringing Advanced Display Technology to Everyday Use

TCL Donates Ultra-Low-Power Display System to the Youth Olympic Village, Bringing Advanced Display Technology to Everyday Use

PR Newswire

DAKAR, Senegal, Oct. 31, 2026

The donation of the display, featuring TCL CSOT's high-brightness Field Sequential Color technology, continues TCL's long-term commitment to the African market

DAKAR, Senegal, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- TCL, a Worldwide Olympic and Paralympic Partner, donated an ultra-low-power display system powered by solar energy to Université Amadou Mahtar Mbow (UAM) in Senegal. Delivering outdoor brightness at roughly half the power consumption of comparable displays, the system will serve as an information hub on the UAM campus, which will also serve as the Youth Olympic Village during the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games.

Attendees at the donation ceremony included IOC President, Kirsty Coventry; UAM President, Professor Mababa Diagne; Senegal Higher Education Minister, Boubacar Camara; TCL Charity Ambassador, Jacky Heung; and General Manager of TCL Industries' Middle East and Africa Marketing Division, Naimin Yang.

"Powered by TCL's advanced display technology, this new display system will create new possibilities for our campus facilities and support development for both students and faculty," said Professor Diagne.

Advanced Display Technology Delivers Best in Brightness and Efficiency

The donated system features a TCL CSOT 75-inch high-brightness Field Sequential Color (FSC) display capable of delivering 4,000-nit brightness at approximately 300W. By eliminating conventional color filters and generating color through the sequential switching of red, green and blue light, FSC technology enhances light utilization with transmittance over 15%.

The technology reflects TCL CSOT's continued pursuit of improved display performance and energy efficiency, bringing advanced screens into everyday settings through TCL's broader Screen Universe vision. Installed at UAM, the display will serve as an outdoor information hub, remaining bright and clear even in direct sunlight.

TCLArt and TCLYoung Champion Local Art and the Next Generation of Creators

Beyond technology, TCL also supports local culture in Dakar through its art-focused initiative, TCLArt. TCL participates in the Yeesal urban art initiative, which works with Senegalese artists and communities to create large-scale public murals. The project supports 43 artists, especially creators under 35, whose works draw inspiration from African athletes, cultural diversity, and youth aspirations. These murals will become permanent features of Dakar's urban landscape, celebrating local creativity while reflecting TCL's commitment to the next generation of creative talent through TCLYoung.

From Local Presence to Shared Growth: TCL Deepens its Footprint in Africa

Both the donation and Yeesal partnership build on a presence in Africa stretching back more than two decades. TCL first entered the African market in 2004. Today, TCL TVs and home appliances are sold in nearly 50 African countries across the continent, supported by six sales subsidiaries and three regional business units. TCL continues to strengthen its retail presence across the region, including with the opening of the first TCL brand experience store in Africa in Johannesburg, and the establishment of its own retail and distribution channel in Kenya.

Through its established business network and localized operations, TCL continues to build closer connections with African customers and consumers, combining global technological capabilities with a deeper understanding of local markets to better serve people across the region.

About TCL

Founded in 1981, TCL is dedicated to empowering smarter, healthier lifestyles through next-generation experiences.

Today, with 50 R&D centers and 47 manufacturing bases globally, TCL operates in over 160 countries and regions, reinforcing its position as a globally competitive smart technology brand. To further inspire greatness, TCL has become an official Worldwide Olympic and Paralympic Partner in the Home Audiovisual Equipment and Home Appliances category.

data.title: GAC Wins 8 Awards, Including 4 First Prizes, Showcasing Technological Innovation Strength
data.description:
GAC Wins 8 Awards, Including 4 First Prizes, Showcasing Technological Innovation Strength

GAC Wins 8 Awards, Including 4 First Prizes, Showcasing Technological Innovation Strength

PR Newswire

SUZHOU, China, Oct. 31, 2026

SUZHOU, China, Oct. 31, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- On October 28, GAC won 8 awards at the 2026 China-SAE Science and Technology Award ceremony in Suzhou, Jiangsu. In the fields of automotive chips, electric drive, vehicle safety, intelligent driving governance and body design, four first prizes were awarded to two GAC-led projects and two GAC-participated projects, and one GAC-led project won second prize.

In chips, GAC's led project built a full-chain path from vehicle definition to scale application, working with 105 partners to apply nearly 400 chip models and over 1,000 domestic chips. The HYPTEC GT Special Edition, China's first ICV with 100% domestically designed chips, has been launched.

In electric drive, GAC pioneered mass production of amorphous alloy stators and carbon-fiber high-speed rotors, becoming the world's only company to mass-produce amorphous alloy automotive motors. Its amorphous ribbon is just 0.025 mm thick. The motor reaches 99.03% peak efficiency, 17.29 kW/kg power density (@1000V)—nearly three times the industry mainstream—and 30,000 rpm maximum speed; system CLTC efficiency reaches 94.184%. For users, energy consumption drops 4%, and range rises 30-50 km with the same battery capacity. It has been applied to HYPTEC, AION and AISTALAND models and promoted to other automakers. The related precision manufacturing technology won the Gold Medal with Congratulations of the Jury at the 51st International Exhibition of Inventions of Geneva.

In safety, the GAC-led project with Tsinghua University won second prize. It developed China's first ASIL-D fully domestic safety controller, real-time risk quantification, active-suspension side-impact mitigation, a rear-window airbag and an "automaker-traffic police-hospital" integrated rescue model. It has been applied to 20 models with cumulative sales of 1.446 million units.

In addition, GAC's participated L2-L4 safety governance project helped establish a full-lifecycle system covering pre-admission, in-process supervision and post-event traceability. Its participated BIW project features an AI-based body design system that generates concept schemes within 5 hours, with over 95% stiffness prediction accuracy and over 30% higher design efficiency; it has been applied to the second-generation GAC GS8, GAC ES9 and GAC All-new S7.

Looking ahead, GAC will uphold innovation-driven development, advance core technology breakthroughs and commercialization, and support high-quality development of China's auto industry.
